metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for day-to-day development: skills, agents and hooks.

plugins.name: usage-ledger
plugins.description: Versioned per-project ledger of Claude Code tokens, list-price cost and active time, attributed by feature and phase, and split into work and questions with optional categories.

plugins.name: did-i-mess-up
plugins.description: Git pre-commit hook for Flutter/Dart repos: blocks debug leftovers, unformatted files, analyze or test failures, and asks Haiku, formally, whether you messed up.
